dialogues.jp: やっと４教科終わったか……。

この後、まだ午後の試験が残っていて、明日も
午後まで試験があって……。
dialogues.en:
And despite having this many before lunch, there's even more
coming in the afternoon...
dialogues.text:
And despite having this many before lunch, there's even more
coming in the afternoon...

dialogues.jp:
まあ、いつまでも溜め息を吐いていても仕方な
い。
dialogues.en: Well, nothing'd be done by just standing around sighing.
dialogues.text: Well, nothing'd be done by just standing around sighing.

dialogues.jp: とりあえず、どこかにいこう。――そして飯だ！
dialogues.en: I should just decide where to go for lunch!
dialogues.text: I should just decide where to go for lunch!

dialogues.jp:
初日の午前中の試験が終わった。この後、午後
と、そして明日の午前、午後と試験はまだまだ
残っている。
dialogues.en:
The morning exams of the first day were over. Still this
afternoon, next morning, and next afternoon to go.
dialogues.text:
The morning exams of the first day were over. Still this
afternoon, next morning, and next afternoon to go.

dialogues.jp:
ま、とりあえず今は飯だ、飯。――少しは勉強
も。
dialogues.en: Oh well, time for lunch, lunch. --And a bit more studying.
dialogues.text: Oh well, time for lunch, lunch. --And a bit more studying.
